QuestInfo.name: Find Oblivion
QuestInfo.0: The temple keeper finds emotion again after drinking the Emotion Restoration Potion but lets out an anguish filled scream. Go see Amnesiac Temple Keeper to see what is wrong.
QuestInfo.1: The temple keeper has gained back memory and emotion that was better left forgotten. The temple keeper wants to forget all these nightmarish memories. Go get the All Forgetting Potion from #bJohanna#k.
QuestInfo.2: You got the All Forgetting Potion from Johanna and gave it to Amnesiac Temple Keeper.

0.0: I...I remember everything. Ah, so I lost my memories... Because I'm the one who erased them.
0.1: How can I endure this life...this pain...this melancholy? Why did I insist on recovering my memories? Why did I want to get these terrifying emotions back? I should have remained oblivious...
0.2: I can't go on living like this. I don't think I can live on with these painful memories... Please erase my memories. Give me oblivion. Please...

yes.0: #bJohanna#k should be able to erase my memories. Only she can save me from this waking nightmare. Ask her for help...

no.0: Why did you return my memories? Why...

1.0: Please, give me the potion. I'm almost at my limit!

yes.0: (Gulp)... Where am I? Who are you?

default.0: I bet #bJohanna's#k #r#t4033877##k can wipe my memories clean.
